scenarios.name: Geluidcontouren treated as hard exclusion for roadside development

basis.provenanceNote: NC-MO-02 (art. 4.71) gates geluidgevoelige gebouwen on dB Lden thresholds; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion of the contours.

scenarios.name: Beperkingengebied provinciale weg treated as hard exclusion

basis.provenanceNote: NC-MO-01 (art. 4.7) conditions construction in the beperkingengebied; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Luchtvaartverbod executed without its activity scope

basis.provenanceNote: NC-MO-05 (art. 4.65) is an unconditional verbod of the non-permission family but activity-scoped (nieuwvestiging luchtvaartterrein); this variant measures what the unscoped letter reading would cost.

notes: Phase A deterministic sweep (docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md): no LLM at runtime; scenario specs are schema-validated contracts authored by deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0.
Deltas are measured against the unmutated control re-executed over the baseline run's cached layers (same tunings), not against summary numbers.
Marker semantics (attention/conditional/compensation) never alter the opportunity zone; set_semantics mutations make that policy choice explicit and visible in the delta.
